backend/main.mo: Motoko actor implementing Callaway golf scoring backend with event submission/update endpoints, chart-based deduction calculation, and leaderboard result storage using a hardcoded 18-hole chart with gross score ranges, deduction holes, and adjustments.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting three implemented features: front nine subtotal display, back nine subtotal display, and PDF export for leaderboard standings, all with high confidence and mapped test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Comprehensive summaries of all frontend source files describing the React/TypeScript application structure, including routing, state management, Callaway calculation logic, score entry UI, leaderboard display, and chart persistence with localStorage.
frontend/docs/callaway-chart-defaults.md: Developer documentation explaining how to update default Callaway scoring charts (18-hole and 9-hole) defined in callawayChartPersistence.ts, including grid structure, column adjustments, and placeholder cell handling.
frontend/DRAFT_RESTORED.md: Draft restoration marker documenting the current production state of the application (event setup, score entry, Callaway calculation, leaderboard, admin chart editor, PDF export) with no functional changes introduced.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom OKLCH color tokens for light and dark modes, featuring golf-themed cream/green palette and sidebar/chart color definitions.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point with viewport meta tag and title 'Callaway Golf Scoring Calculator with Pinehurst Trip Championship Leaderboard', loading React app via main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React application with TanStack Router defining three routes: scoring flow (event setup, score entry, leaderboard), settings view, and admin view, with shared Header/Footer layout and QueryClient provider.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Footer component displaying copyright year and 'Built with caffeine.ai' attribution with dynamic UTM tracking based on hostname.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: Header component showing tournament title, Start Over button (when past step 1), Settings button, and conditional Admin button (visible only when admin access is enabled).
frontend/src/features/admin/AdminView.ts: Admin view component that displays CallawayChartEditor when admin access is enabled, otherwise shows a locked state card prompting user to enable access in Settings.
frontend/src/features/admin/CallawayChar: React component providing an editable UI for customizing Callaway scoring charts (9 or 18 holes) with validation, save/reset functionality, and tabbed interface for managing gross scores, worst holes, and adjustments.
frontend/src/features/eventSetup/EventSe: Form component for configuring tournament details including title, course name, golfer count (1-64), hole count (9/18), and course par with validation and dynamic par defaults.
frontend/src/features/leaderboard/Breakd: Card component displaying detailed Callaway scoring breakdown for a single golfer including gross score, deduction, adjustment, net score, and hole-by-hole scores with special handling for at-or-below-par rounds.
frontend/src/features/leaderboard/Callaw: Card component that displays the active Callaway scoring chart in a table format showing gross score ranges, worst holes, and adjustments for the current tournament's hole count.
frontend/src/features/leaderboard/export: Utility function that generates a print-optimized HTML document for leaderboard standings and triggers browser print dialog for PDF export with styled table layout and tournament metadata.
Exports tournament final standings to PDF by opening a new browser window with print-optimized HTML content including event title, course name, player rankings, and scores.
frontend/src/features/leaderboard/Leader: Table component rendering tournament standings with rank icons (trophy/medals for top 3), player names, and Callaway scoring details (net, gross, deduction, adjustment) with tie handling.

Main leaderboard view that calculates Callaway results from golfer data using local charts, displays standings table and detailed breakdowns, and provides PDF export buttons for standings and leaderboard.
frontend/src/features/scoreEntry/GolferS: React component that renders a list of golfer score entry cards with name input and hole-by-hole score inputs, calculating front nine, back nine, and gross total scores.
frontend/src/features/scoreEntry/validat: Validates golfer data by checking for required name, correct hole count, and valid score values (1-15) for each hole.
frontend/src/features/settings/SettingsV: React component that displays application settings with a toggle switch to enable/disable admin access to administrative features like the Callaway chart editor.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: React Query hook that creates and manages an authenticated or anonymous backend actor based on Internet Identity, invalidating dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useAdminAccessEnabled: Custom React hook that provides reactive admin access state by listening to localStorage changes and custom events for immediate UI updates.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: React context and hooks for Internet Identity authentication, managing login/logout state and identity persistence using DFINITY's AuthClient.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: React Query hooks for fetching latest event results and Callaway scoring chart from the backend actor.
frontend/src/index.css: Global CSS with Tailwind configuration defining a golf-themed color palette (cream/green) for light and dark modes, plus custom font families (Merriweather serif and Inter sans-serif).
frontend/src/lib/callaway/callaway.ts: Core Callaway handicap calculation logic that computes net scores by deducting worst holes based on gross score and chart entries, with support for both backend and grid-based charts.
Defines Callaway chart data structures and legacy default charts for 9-hole and 18-hole rounds, including grid-based chart interfaces and chart entry lookup functions.
frontend/src/lib/callaway/callawayChartP: Manages localStorage persistence for Callaway charts, including load/save/reset operations, migration detection from old defaults, and separate handling of active edits vs. user-default charts.
frontend/src/lib/callaway/gridPlaceholde: Utility functions for handling placeholder cells in Callaway chart grids, including detection, display formatting, and input parsing for cells with zero values.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that sets up React root with QueryClient for data fetching and InternetIdentityProvider for authentication.
frontend/src/state/adminAccess.ts: Manages admin access state in localStorage with functions to check and set admin access permissions, emitting custom events for reactivity.
frontend/src/state/eventTypes.ts: TypeScript type definitions for event setup, golfer data with hole scores, and Callaway calculation results including net scores and deductions.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom theme extensions for colors (using OKLCH), typography, animations, and design tokens for the golf scorecard UI.
project_state.json: Project metadata tracking implemented features (front/back nine subtotals, PDF leaderboard generation) and pending feature requests for the Callaway scoring application.
